About.storyText: ARIGEO Co., Ltd. was established with a clear determination to distribute essential products that improve the quality of everyday life — blending advanced safety, rigorous standards, and professional care across household and skincare solutions.

About.visionText: To be a leading gateway of innovative household and skincare solutions, elevating health, safety, and sustainable living for everyone.
missionItems: Source and distribute premium-quality products certified by high standards.

captainMaid.name: Captain Maid
captainMaid.positioning: Smart, safe, and effective household care essentials.
captainMaid.story: Captain Maid was developed with the clear goal of providing highly effective cleaning solutions that never compromise on household safety. Every formula is carefully designed to keep your living spaces spotlessly clean while keeping the environment safe and comfortable for your loved ones.

genuLeaf.name: GenuLeaf
genuLeaf.story: GenuLeaf brings the power of natural botanicals and active soothing ingredients together to nurture and hydrate your skin every day. Our gentle formulas focus on barrier health, brightening, and mild cleansing suitable for daily protection.

ceraTory.name: CeraTory
ceraTory.positioning: Derma-skincare targeting specialized barrier and acne care.
ceraTory.story: CeraTory is engineered for specialized skincare needs. By utilizing advanced ceramide complexes and targeted clinical compounds, CeraTory delivers deep skin barrier reinforcement and gentle acne care solutions.
